notes.title: HAPPY RELEASE DAY! (v50 patch)
notes.notes:
THE GAME IS OUT!! Hurray!! **CELEBRATION** WE did it, thank youuuu --- This is huuuuuge! Amazing launch day!

Okay, while you are celebrating (and playing Grand Strokers!) we have been hard at work (NOT LIKE THAT!) dropping the latest funky fresh patch. We proudly present to you --- v50.

It includes (but not limited to):

-Added a FULLSCREEN plugin from opheliaenigma called the "Fullscreen Resolution Override plugin for rpg maker mv". 

-Adjusted the CREDITS page slightly.

-Caught and fixed a error on the Dragon Plate Mail flavor text.

-Would you believe that the same aforementioned Dragon Plate Mail was also programmed to equip and wear as an accessory and not body? Yep, that is now corrected! REJOICE!

-We added more FRIENDS to the tombstones around the world graveyard and in the town graveyard. THANK YOU for the continuous support! <3 

-Added more places to "inspect" around the maps.

-Furry Humpman now "transforms" into a wolf. It's not much but... it is improvement!

Please note there is a game category on both Kick and Twitch if you are streaming the game.

THANK you for making our dreams come true!!! YOU ROCK!!

Faithfully yours,



-NCG-

notes.title: New Update (version 15) of GRAND STROKERS!
notes.notes:
We did a few changes to the game including : 

Added a few enemies to the game including 8 different colored coomies and a mini-boss (The TechniSplooge)!! We also did the following changes:

-Splooge sword from Small Enchanted Sticks no longer drops. Small Enchanted Sticks now drop a BOOMSWORD.

-Bloodbat now has a chance to poison. In addition, you also have a chance to contract RABIES (debuff).

-Equipping MONSTROUS drops now play a Sound Effect!

-Changed the Purple Splooge (Acidic Splooge) to drop a "purple drop" (used to summon the Technosplooge). We also added a change for the Acidic Splooge to poison you on hit.

-Shards from gems (Gram Stroker dungeons) can now be used to craft a GEM SWORD! 

-2 buildings at the start of the game can now be entered! (One for crafting, one for summoning new miniboss).

-Poisonous Swamp #2 (East side) went to the OLD map, fixed this!!

-Wolf Whistle to summon Furry Humpman now has a whistle sound when you use it!! 

-Furry Humpman, Grossferatu, and Horsie are now in the Enemy Book!!

-Moving the table in the Silver Mountain of Transmission and Reception will earn you 1 xp! Push it and level up your character. 

-All MONSTROUS helm drop to Grossferatu


THANKS FOR THE SUPPORT, MY FRIENDS!

Please add game to your wishlist if it isn't already!


-NecroCaticGames-
